sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section II, Histaklut Penimit 8

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section II, Histaklut Penimit 8:1
items.html:
It explains: A. Why in the drawing of the lights the coarser is always greater, and in their clothing in the vessels the more refined is always more important. B. The reason for the reverse order between the vessels and the lights, whereby in the vessels the upper ones grow first, and in the lights the lower ones enter first. C. Why the circles are considered the light of Nefesh.

The measure of the greatness of the light drawn depends on the measure of coarseness of the screen.
And it was well explained how all the measure of the greatness of the influence of the upper light in the emanated being depends on the measure of coarseness of the screen, since the greater coarseness, that of phase four, is influenced at the level of Keter, and what is less than it is influenced only at the level of Hochma, and so on until the more refined screen, to which the upper light does not influence anything, since it has no coarseness, as explained.

The measure of the greatness of the light that clothes depends on the refinement of the vessel.
However all this is said with regard to the influence and expansion of the upper light to the emanated being, for every one who influences, influences the coarser thing, since the coarser the screen, the more the upper light expands to it (see Histaklut Penimit, Part 2, item 62, Sub Header, “Now,” that the drawing of phase four is called the expansion of the upper light). However, with regard to the order of reception by the emanated being of the upper light, it is not so; rather the more important light is received in the more refined vessel, and the lower one is received in the coarser vessel.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section II, Histaklut Penimit 8:2
items.html:
In the vessels the upper ones come first, and in the lights the lower ones come first.
And this is what we said above (Chapter 2, item 14, Sub Header, “And there is”), that every one who influences, influences the coarser thing, but every one who receives, receives the more refined thing. And in order to explain this to you, I will explain to you the order of the entry of the lights into the emanated being after the correction, when it receives the lights little by little, in the order of the degree, so that first it attains the light of Nefesh, and then it attains the light of Ruach, and so on, up to the light of Yechida. And in the vessels it is the reverse, for first it attains Keter, and then Hochma, and so on.

When it attains the light of Nefesh, it clothes in the vessel of Keter.
And this is the order: first the emanated being comes out in the aspect of ten vessels, namely Keter, Hochma, Bina, ZA, comprising HGT NHY, and Malchut, that is, the upper vessels come first. And afterward, when the Nefesh is influenced to it, this Nefesh is considered to come to it in the vessel of Keter, which is the more refined vessel. And the reason it has no light of Ruach yet is that the screen in the Keter has no coarseness whatsoever, not even of phase one, and the aspect of the light of Ruach is influenced only through the meeting of the upper light with the screen of phase one. And since the screen is in the vessel of Keter, meaning the screen is refined without any coarseness at all, it therefore has only the light of Nefesh, which is ascribed to Malchut.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section II, Histaklut Penimit 8:3
items.html:
When it attains the light of Ruach, the light of Nefesh descends to Hochma, and the Ruach clothes in the vessel of Keter.
And when it acquires the coarseness of phase one, then, through the meeting of the upper light with this screen of phase one, the light of Ruach is influenced to it. And the place of this screen is in the vessel of Hochma, which is phase one. However, although the screen of the vessel of Hochma is what drew the light of Ruach to the Partzuf, nevertheless the light of Ruach clothes in the vessel of Keter, and the light of Nefesh, which it had before in Keter, descends to Hochma. And the reason is as said, that in the order of reception of the lights, the more important light clothes in the more refined vessel, and the lower one below it in the coarser vessel, that is, the reverse of the order of influence; hence the Ruach, which is more important than Nefesh, rises and clothes in Keter, and the Nefesh descends and clothes in Hochma.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section II, Histaklut Penimit 8:4
items.html:
And when it attains Neshama, it clothes in the vessel of Keter, and the Ruach descends to Hochma, and the Nefesh to Bina.
And after that, when its screen acquires the coarseness of phase two, which is considered that the screen is in the vessel of Bina, then, through the meeting of the upper light with this screen, the light of Neshama, which is more important than the lights of Ruach and Nefesh, is influenced to it. And here too it receives the light of Neshama in the more refined thing, meaning in the vessel of Keter, since the light of Nefesh, the lowest of all, which is in the vessel of Hochma, descends to the vessel of Bina, where the screen of phase two now is, which is now the coarsest vessel of all. And the light of Ruach descends from Keter to the vessel of Hochma, and the light of Neshama, the most important of all, clothes in the vessel of Keter, the most refined of all.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section II, Histaklut Penimit 8:5
items.html:
And when it attains the light of Haya, it clothes in Keter, and the Neshama descends to Hochma, and the Ruach to Bina, and the Nefesh to ZA.
And when its screen acquires the coarseness of phase three, it is considered that the screen is now in the vessel of ZA, which is phase three. And then, through the meeting of the upper light with this screen of phase three, the light of Haya, which is even more important than the light of Neshama, is influenced to it, and it must therefore be received in the more refined vessel. Hence the light of Nefesh, the lowest of all, descends from the vessel of Bina to the vessel that is now the coarsest of all, which is the vessel of ZA, where the screen of phase three now is. And the light of Ruach, which was in Hochma, now descends to Bina. And the light of Neshama, which was in Keter, descends to Hochma. And the light of Haya, the most important of all, clothes in the vessel of Keter.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section II, Histaklut Penimit 8:6
items.html:
And when it attains Yechida, it clothes in Keter, and the Haya descends to Hochma, and the Neshama to Bina, and the Ruach to ZA, and the Nefesh to Malchut.
And afterward, when the screen acquires the coarseness of phase four, it is considered that the screen is now in the vessel of Malchut, which is phase four. And then, through the meeting of the upper light with this screen of phase four, the light of Yechida, the most important of all, is influenced to it, and it is therefore received in the more refined thing, that is, in the vessel of Keter. Hence the light of Nefesh, the lowest of all, descends from ZA to the vessel of Malchut, where the screen of phase four is, and it is the coarsest of all. And the light of Ruach descends from Bina to the vessel of ZA. And the light of Neshama descends from Hochma to the vessel of Bina. And the light of Haya descends from Keter to the vessel of Hochma. And the light of Yechida, which has now come, clothes in Keter. And now every light of NRNHY has reached the true vessel ascribed to it.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section II, Histaklut Penimit 8:7
items.html:
The difference from the influence of the light to the order of the clothing of the light.
And you see the great difference between the order of the influence of the upper light to the Partzuf and the order of the clothing of the light in the vessels. For the one who influences needs the coarsest phase, since the light of Yechida is not influenced to the Partzuf except when a screen is found there in the vessel of phase four specifically, as explained, so that beforehand, when this coarseness was not there, but only a thinner coarseness than it, that is, of phase three, it was not possible for this important light, called Yechida, to be influenced in the Partzuf. Yet, when this important light is drawn to the Partzuf, it does not clothe in the vessel of phase four, but in the most refined of all, that is, in the vessel of Keter.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section II, Histaklut Penimit 8:8
items.html:
Every light that comes to the Partzuf is received only in the vessel of Keter.
And likewise the aspect of the light of Haya, which is influenced only with a screen that is in the vessel of ZA, that is, phase three, yet when it clothes in the emanated being, it does not clothe in the vessel of ZA, but in the more refined vessel, that is, in the vessel of Keter, as explained. And likewise, the aspect of the light of Neshama is influenced only with a screen coarser than phase two, in the vessel of Bina, yet when it clothes in it, it clothes only in the vessel of Keter. And so too the light of Ruach, which is influenced only with the screen of phase one in the vessel of Hochma, yet when it clothes in it, it does not clothe in the vessel of Hochma, but in the more refined vessel, that is, the vessel of Keter, as explained. Thus every light that comes to the Partzuf does not come to it at first except in the vessel of Keter, as we said, that every receiver receives only in the more refined vessel, even though the influence reached it in the coarser vessel. Understand this well.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section II, Histaklut Penimit 8:9
items.html:
The circles do not receive the upper light since they have no coarseness.
And from what has been explained you will also understand why the circles do not receive any influence from the upper light at all, but rather all the lights in them must receive from the light of the line, even though the vessels of the circles precede the vessels of the straightness of the line. And the matter is simple: because they have no coarseness at all, since all four phases in them are on one equal footing, as above (Part 1, Chapter 1, item 100, Sub Header, “Circle”). Therefore only the vessels of the straightness in the line, which have screen and coarseness, are the ones influenced by the upper light, and the circles receive from them.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section II, Histaklut Penimit 8:10
items.html:
Every degree that receives through another, and does not itself have the aspect of influence, is called Nefesh.
Therefore the light of the circles is called by the name light of Nefesh, for this is the rule: every degree that is not influenced by the upper light, but receives its illumination through another degree, that light is called the light of Nefesh, or the light of the female. And since the circles are not influenced by the upper light, but receive their illumination through the line, they are in the aspect of the light of the female, or the light of Nefesh. And also regarding the vessels of the straightness, it was explained above (Histaklut Penimit, Part 2, item 85, Sub Header, “And after”) that if all the coarseness in the screen has been refined, there is no longer any influence from the upper light there, and there is only illumination from the degree preceding it, which is therefore called the light of Nefesh, see there well.
